title: Pope Asks Putin for a Cease-Fire for a Ukrainian City Under Siege
summary: Recovering from lung cancer surgery, Pope Leo XIV spoke with Vladimir V. Putin to make a plea for Oleshky, where mines and drones have trapped some 2,000 people who are at risk of starvation.
